statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-40468 is an integer overflow in gawk's do_sub() (builtin.c), where the length of the result built so far ('sofar') was an int. Debian's tracker names upstream commit 062f2f25 as the fix, which makes 'sofar' a size_t and also widens the accumulator in parse_escape() (node.c) (https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-40468, https://cgit.git.savannah.gnu.org/cgit/gawk.git/commit/?id=062f2f2581b991362c046f7f2e238ffa34e6f8c7). DHI gawk for Alpine 3.23 packages gawk 5.3.2 and has three builds published by 2026-11-28: 5.3.2-r2, 5.3.2-r3 and 5.3.2-r4, each for x86_64 and aarch64. 5.3.2-r4 is the first build that carries a backport of both changes to 5.3.2. We checked the do_sub() change by disassembling usr/bin/gawk in all six builds: in 5.3.2-r2 and 5.3.2-r3, do_sub() truncates the 'bp - buf' length to 32 bits and sign-extends it before the final buffer-size check; in 5.3.2-r4 it uses the full 64-bit length. 5.3.2-r3 was built without the backport and reads as affected.
